items.event: Baycurrent Classic, final round (Yokohama CC, Japan)
items.line: Eight players sit within one shot of the lead heading into Sunday. Michael Brennan, Zach Bauchou and Jacob Bridgeman are on 13 under, and Adam Scott (65 on Saturday) is one back, chasing his first PGA Tour win in six years.
